content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the text does not provide specific details about the parties involved or the case itself however it mentions various fees and expenses paid by both the applicant and the defendant in the final resolution of a matrimonial property case the court awarded the applicant half of the apartment one vehicle and a certain amount of funds the defendant was also awarded half of the apartment one vehicle and a different amount of funds from a life insurance company the court ordered the applicant to compensate the defendant for higher value assets acquired during the marriage there is also a credit agreement between the parties and a bank that may be subject to modification the text refers to several articles from the civil code that are relevant to the case it outlines the progress of a divorce case between ms evg the applicant and mr ag the defendant the applicant is seeking a divorce requesting the dissolution of the marriage due to the defendants fault and asking for the defendant to pay maintenance for their minor children the court is asked to establish the residence of the children with the applicant and order the defendant to make monthly child support payments the applicant also seeks the division of property acquired during the marriage including a recreational premises and funds from a life insurance company the court is asked to award the applicant a larger share of the property and establish her right to use it without prejudice to the interests of the creditor the defendant objects to some of the applicants claims and requests the establishment of his own residence with the children and the award of certain assets to him the court must also consider the claims of creditors and determine the division of obligations between the parties the court has decided to support a counterclaim made by one of the parties which requests the dissolution of the marriage stating that both spouses are at fault the court has awarded half of the apartment and vehicle funds to the applicant and the other half to the defendant the applicant is ordered to pay compensation to the defendant for higher value assets acquired during the marriage both parties are ordered to pay compensation for credit installments on each others privatelyowned apartments the court dismisses the remainder of the counterclaim the defendant is ordered to pay the applicants costs of proceedings and stamp duty and the applicant is ordered to pay stamp duty to the state the defendant is also ordered to pay stamp duty for periodical maintenance claims for their children and for the recovery of maintenance arrears
